Name: Tree Shake Products
Author: EliteWise
Description:
Gives mature trees a 5% chance to drop one of their tapper products when shaken.

[table][tr][th]Tree[/th]
[th]Extra product[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Maple Tree[/td]
[td]Maple Syrup[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Oak Tree[/td]
[td]Oak Resin[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Pine Tree[/td]
[td]Pine Tar[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Mahogany Tree[/td]
[td]Sap[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td]Mystic Tree[/td]
[td]Mystic Syrup[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
The chance is rolled only on the tree's first shake of the day. Later shakes of the same tree cannot produce another product; the tree becomes eligible again the next day. All normal shake drops are preserved.
